name: old-town-morning
ffmpegCommand: ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 30 -start_number 0 -i output/frames/old-town-morning/frame_%04d.png -frames:v 360 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=neighbor:out_color_matrix=bt709:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -tune animation -profile:v high -level:v 4.1 -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -color_range tv -r 30 -movflags +faststart -f mp4 output/video/old-town-morning.mp4
